prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1338; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle shows crush and paint transfer along the rear passenger quarter panel, with a cracked taillight lens and a bent rear wheel rim consistent with a side strike at an intersection. Some of the lower rocker area looks older than the rest of the damage, so it is not clear whether all of it came from this impact, and I have asked the shop to confirm. The repair plan covers panel replacement, refinishing, and a wheel and lamp swap. The labor hours fit the damage described. The bills show no repeated charges, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known to me.
